3:92.text: By no means shall you attain Al-Birr
(piety, righteousness - here it means Allâh’s Reward, i.e. Paradise)
of that which you love; and whatever of good you spend, Allâh knows it well.

3:93.text: All food was lawful to the Children of Israel, except what Israel made unlawful for himself before the Taurât
and recite it, if you are truthful."

3:94.text: Then after that, whosoever shall invent a lie against Allâh, ... such shall indeed be the Zâlimûn

3:95.text: : "Allâh has spoken the truth; follow the religion of Ibrâhîm
(Islâmic Monotheism, i.e. he used to worship Allâh Alone)
, and he was not of Al-Mushrikûn "

3:96.text: appointed for mankind was that at Bakkah
, full of blessing, and a guidance for Al-‘Âlamîn

3:97.text: ; whosoever enters it, he attains security. And Hajj
is a duty that mankind owes to Allâh, those who can afford the expenses
[i.e. denies Hajj (pilgrimage to Makkah), then he is a disbeliever of Allâh]
, then Allâh stands not in need of any of the ‘Âlamîn

3:98.text: ! Why do you reject the Ayât of Allâh
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
while Allâh is Witness to what you do?"

3:99.text: ! Why do you stop those who have believed, from the Path of Allâh, seeking to make it seem crooked, while you
[to Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم as a Messenger of Allâh and Islâm (Allâh’s religion, i.e. to worship none but Him Alone)]
? And Allâh is not unaware of what you do."

3:100.text: O you who believe! If you obey a group of those who were given the Scripture
render you disbelievers after you have believed!
